paragraphs: The X1 sDrive18i has been part of the BMW X1 range since 2015, spanning two generations under one badge. The F48 generation (2015–2022) uses the B38 — a 1.5-litre turbocharged three-cylinder petrol engine. From 2022, the U11-generation X1 sDrive18i switched to the B48, a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder unit that's a different engine entirely, not an evolution of the B38. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and rebuild specifics differ between them — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 sDrive18i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the X1 sDrive18i spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming a B38 part will work on a U11 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X1 sDrive18i quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
